text: Risk management is the process of finding and dealing with possible problems before they happen. The first step is identifying risks, which means looking carefully at what could go wrong in a project or business. Once risks are known, you need mitigation strategies to reduce their impact or the chance they will occur. It is also wise to prepare contingency plans, so you have a backup solution if things fail. Finally, monitoring is essential because risks change over time, and new ones can appear. By following these steps, individuals and companies can protect themselves and make better decisions.
